payload.friendly_name: Off-host dead-man pings for the on-host watchers
payload.purpose_context: felix-canary and felix-health-check watch each other (#1063) but share one host, one user manager, one checkout and one ntfy topic, so losing any of them silences both. RFC #1069 decided that both watchers ping a hosted dead-man service (healthchecks.io) after each successful run and send a fail ping when an alert cannot be delivered; the service emails Kent, never through ntfy. Ping URLs are capability secrets kept on office2, never in the repo. Tracks kentonium3/kg-automation#1077.
payload.purpose_tldr: If office2, its user manager, the checkout or the ntfy alert channel goes down, Kent still gets an email, because the two on-host watchers stop pinging a hosted dead-man service.
